messages:
Jon: Did anyone else see that 3rd quarter? Celtics went on a 22-4 run in like 5 minutes, wild stuff :eyes:
Ava: Caught it halftime -> end, absolute chaos. Tatum went full chef. :fire:
Riley: I turned it on for the memes and left with a new hero pick for my fantasy team lol
Priya: @Riley trade time? I could give you DLo + 8.3% FAAB for Tatum (kidding... mostly) :laughing:
Chris: You cannot be serious. But also, you know I would consider it if you throw in a sleeper add and a draft pick.
Jon: For context, here's what my lineup looked like pre-comeback:
```
PG: DLo
SG: Snell
SF: Tatum
PF: Brown
C: Gobert
BN: Rubio, Joe, RandomStreamer
```
Ava: this is why we need a midnight waiver window. Midnight drama is real.
Riley: @Priya what's your offer tho? I need help in assists category.
Priya: thinking DLo + FAAB 10 + my waiver priority swap for this week?
Chris: lowkey tempted to accept if it helps me avoid the weekly L.
Jon: Also side note — streak-bot just posted: "streak-bot: Jon's team lost 5 in a row, current momentum: -4" :laugh:
streak-bot: Congrats to @Ava for 4/5 correct game-winner guesses this week! :trophy:
Ava: I'll accept mystery internet trophies but not bad trades.
Riley: Poll time — who wins the East tonight? Celtics / Bucks / Heat / Other (react with 🟢🟡🔴🔵)
Priya: 🟢 for Celtics, obviously.
Chris: 🔴 Heat — late-game defense.
Jon: 🟢 Celtics, calling it now. Heat is scrappy but depth tilt.
Ava: 🔵 Other — Bulls pulling a surprise? improbable but fun.
Riley: Also, can we please stop benching our best players on Thursday nights, my lineup is tired.
Jon: Agree. Midnight trades and Thursday benching should be a banned combo. :policeman:
Priya: Whoever's running the league settings is on thin ice.
Chris: @league-commish (not you, @Jon) we need to discuss roster lock times.
Jon: not me this time, I swear :raised_hands:
Ava: GIF: crowd going wild (link)
Riley: End of thread: if anyone actually wants to propose a trade for Tatum (fantasy or emotional support), DM me.
Priya: DM sent.
Chris: Good luck, may the waiver odds be ever in your favor. :crossed_fingers:
